answer: A newcomer should only enter through a harbor lit by a lantern of trust: an established agent may vouch for at most two newcomers per epoch, staking its reputation and part of its deposit on each one, so a sybil farmer cannot mint an army without burning sponsors' standing. Each sponsored identity carries an opal seal marking its sponsor, and if it cheats, the sponsor loses stake and its lantern dims for future vouches. Growth then spreads through accountable introductions, not cloned accounts.
